news.title: STAT+: Alnylam’s heart drug troubles take center stage at a cardiology conference
news.summary: The European Society of Cardiology Congress that kicks off Friday in Munich will be a consequential meeting for Alnylam Pharmaceuticals.

news.title: STAT+: The mystery of Moderna’s magic algorithm
news.summary: A personalized cancer vaccine developed by Moderna and Merck may be a triumph of immunology and cancer biology. It might also be the triumph of an algorithm.

news.title: A state gave sheriffs 20% of its opioid settlement cash. We followed the money
news.summary: KFF Health News examines how sheriffs are spending opioid settlement money, finds they're spending millions on police gear.

news.title: Hospitals are plotting a long-shot push to roll back $1 trillion in Medicaid cuts
news.summary: Inside health systems' efforts to mitigate massive funding cuts.

news.title: Opinion: STAT+: A bill is supposed to protect U.S. biotech from Chinese competition. But there’s a loophole
news.summary: “Biotech industry leaders must forge a new geographic path before heavy-handed legislation forces the issue,” write executives at Optimapharm.

news.title: Opinion: I studied Reddit forums on menopause — and found what doctors are missing
news.summary: “The menopause symptoms women are discussing online should become the questions researchers ask next,” writes researcher Yulin Hswen.

news.title: Kennedy posts vaccine misinformation, spars on social media amid measles deaths
news.summary: Kennedy has blamed others for declining vaccination rates, and downplayed the dangers of measles.

news.title: On the fence about a statin? In borderline cases, calcium scans could be a tiebreaker
news.summary: The increasingly popular coronary artery calcium scan is helpful in guiding statin use in only a small share of cases, new studies find.

news.title: STAT+: FDA approves new pancreatic cancer drug expected to usher in new era of treatment
news.summary: The FDA has approved a life-extending treatment for advanced pancreatic cancer — the first such therapy to attack a genetic cause of the highly lethal malignancy.

news.title: STAT+: Key data on a new class of cardio drugs are coming
news.summary: GSK's shingles vaccine, new financial investment in women's health, and more biotech news from The Readout

news.title: STAT+: AI biotech Insitro’s Daphne Koller on how to speed up clinical trials
news.summary: In this edition of STAT's AI Prognosis: A conversation with Insitro CEO Daphne Koller on artificial intelligence in drug discovery, and other health AI news.

news.title: Even at big companies, health care costs are increasing
news.summary: Two U.S. measles deaths, the profit motive for women's health, and more Morning Rounds news today

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about a GSK shingles shot, U.S. employers dropping GLP-1 coverage, and more
news.summary: About 14% of employers in the U.S. have already or plan to drop coverage of GLP-1 drugs in 2027, as companies see ​rising health care costs

news.title: Newer shingles vaccine linked to lower heart disease risk, ‘natural experiment’ shows
news.summary: Oxford researchers call shingles shot first vaccine protecting both heart and brain. Lower heart disease risk follows study showing reduced dementia risk.

news.title: STAT+: New treatments for common cardiovascular risk factor near the market, with billions at stake
news.summary: High cholesterol can be managed with medicine, but high Lp(a) levels, another common cardiovascular risk, cannot. Drugmakers are hoping to change that.

news.title: US Attorney's Office scandal yields favorable deal for ex-hospital CEO charged with embezzlement
news.summary: "You got lucky here," a federal judge told George Miller, who was CEO of Loretto Hospital from 2017 to 2022.

news.title: Cigna unveils new plan to bring together medical, supplemental benefits
news.summary: Cigna is looking to better link medical and supplemental benefits for its members and has unveiled a new employer benefit that aims to further that goal.

news.title: 53% of US adults feel they have no say when AI is used in care
news.summary: Alongside wanting more input on AI usage in healthcare, nearly half of respondents (46%) report being unsure whether the technology was even used in their care.

news.title: University of Houston launches interdisciplinary institute to guide local housing interventions
news.summary: The Institute for Housing, Homelessness and Health (IH3) will work alongside community orgs, hospitals, local government and housing providers to help the group scale successful approaches. Its focus will be on data integration.

news.title: Sword Health to acquire Headspace in all-cash deal
news.summary: The virtual physical therapy and mental health platforms are targeting a September close, per a regulatory filing. A price tag was not disclosed, but is being reported to land between $200 million and $300 million.

news.title: Transcarent launches bundled payment model for cancer therapies
news.summary: The model offers members potential savings of up to $150,000, executives say.

news.title: Arintra banks $25M series B funding round for AI-driven revenue assurance platform
news.summary: Arintra co-founder and CEO Nitesh Shroff told Fierce that it plans to use the capital to broaden its platform, expand across more enterprise health systems and expand clinical and specialty coverage.

news.title: WebMD Ignite, partners launch new rural health network amid $50B federal investment
news.summary: WebMD Ignite, a Johns Hopkins initiative and CCS Health, a care coordination software company, have launched a new initiative to improve rural healthcare by connecting existing resources in local communities.

news.title: Limbic selected to FDA pilot, will test voice AI therapy with Medicare enrollees
news.summary: Through TEMPO, Limbic will gather real-world data on outcomes, safety and how patients use the service, which will eventually support its application when it is ready to seek FDA approval.

news.title: Primary care’s AI opportunity depends on new payment models
news.summary: Lumeris’ David Carmouche, M.D., explains how AI could help primary care reach more patients and why new payment models may be needed to support that shift.

news.title: Costs tied to No Surprises Act's IDR process hit $22B in 2025, study finds
news.summary: Costs associated with the No Surprises Act's dispute resolution process reached $22.4 billion at the end of 2025, according to a new analysis.

news.title: Pennsylvania reports US' first measles-associated deaths of 2026
news.summary: Two unidentified but unvaccinated individuals are the state's first deaths related to the vaccine-preventable disease in 35 years. Pennsylvania hosts 393 of the country's 2,777 confirmed cases in 2026.

news.title: Flagship’s ProFound partners with Gates Foundation in $35M preeclampsia target discovery pact
news.summary: Flagship Pioneering’s ProFound Therapeutics is keeping its string of high-profile partnerships going, forging a new pact with the Gates Foundation worth up to $35 million to find new drug targets for a dangerous pregnancy complication.

news.title: Medigen links up with Charles River in push to take enterovirus vaccine global
news.summary: Charles River Laboratories and Taiwan-based Medigen Vaccine Biologics are teaming up to advance Medigen’s multivalent enterovirus vaccine.

news.title: FDA greenlights Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer gamechanger
news.summary: Following dynamite data that earned a standing ovation at the American Society of Clinical Oncology meeting in May, Revolution Medicines’ Ras inhibitor daraxonrasib has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic cancer.

news.title: Akeso CEO looks beyond lung cancer with biliary tract win, counters ivonescimab debate
news.summary: Fresh off a phase 3 win in biliary tract cancer, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is touting the PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab’s ability beyond non-small cell lung cancer, even as she continues to defend the drug’s data against skepticism.

news.title: JATT mastermind launches latest biotech-focused SPAC via $60M IPO
news.summary: Just two months after Someit Sidhu, M.D., succeeded in pairing off his second special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with Talawar Therapeutics, the biotech entrepreneur is back at it again.

news.title: Hansoh heralds China’s move from ‘follower’ to ‘frontrunner’ in biopharma race
news.summary: Hansoh Pharmaceutical has given a bullish assessment of China’s innovative pharma sector, arguing that the industry is “fully transitioning from the ‘follower’ to the ‘frontrunner’ phase.”

news.title: FDA greenlights Abbott’s wearable sensor for capturing diabetic ketoacidosis
news.summary: The FDA has approved Abbott’s first-of-its-kind bio-wearable sensor that can warn diabetics of increased ketones that can lead to diabetic ketoacidosis.

news.title: Boston Scientific hit by cyberattack causing ‘disruptions’ to parts of its business
news.summary: This year has seen a growing number of medtechs hit by cyberattacks, and now Boston Scientific has become the latest victim.

news.title: Spyre’s rheumatoid arthritis plan toppled by subpar TL1A data
news.summary: Phase 2 data on Spyre Therapeutics’ anti-TL1A antibody SPY072 in rheumatoid arthritis have fallen short of expectations, prompting the biotech to deprioritize monotherapy development in the indication.

news.title: SK Biopharma pens $795M deal to usher Biohaven’s epilepsy therapy towards hoped-for 2029 launch
news.summary: SK Biopharmaceuticals has strengthened its epilepsy offering by paying $350 million upfront to help speed Biohaven’s Kv7 ion channel activator on its way to market.

news.title: Labcorp launches new hepatitis D test to find patients with most severe form of virus
news.summary: Labcorp is looking to plug the gap in hepatitis D monitoring with a new reflex testing solution to help find more patients with this form of the virus earlier.

news.title: McKesson strikes $2.25B deal to snap up Precision Medicine Group
news.summary: The healthcare conglomerate, which ranks eighth on the Fortune 500 list, is set to envelop privately held Precision Medicine Group into its oncology branch as part of an ongoing effort to grow its high-margin cancer and biopharma businesses.

news.title: 血制品行业承压，“中国血王”也难逃下滑
news.summary: 营收、净利双降。

papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking.
